process_restart_impact: In-flight jobs are terminated if process restarts; job records remain in STARTED/QUEUED state in PostgreSQL
recovery_path: Operator or UI can trigger re-processing via POST /documents/{id}/reprocess
idempotency: Ingestion safely purges old chunks and vectors before inserting newly parsed chunks
production_recommendation: For enterprise production scaling, migrate from asyncio.create_task to Celery / ARQ / BullMQ with dedicated worker instances
